title: Remove scroll effect and change hero background to white

requirements.text: Remove any scroll-based parallax or animation effects from the homepage hero section

quotes: quita el efecto de scroll en la pagina de inicio

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section no longer has scroll-triggered animations or parallax effects
Content remains static during page scroll

requirements.text: Change the hero section background image to a white/blank background to improve text readability

quotes: deja la imagen de fondo en blanco para que todo sea mas legible

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section background is white or very light colored
All text in the hero section has sufficient contrast and is easily readable
The hero background image is no longer visible or has been replaced with a solid white background

constraints: Do not edit files in frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui/
Preserve all existing Spanish text and content in the hero section
nonGoals: Changing text content or CTAs in the hero section
Modifying other sections beyond the hero
